title: Mobile App Portfolio
description: A calm collection of small, useful mobile apps built from the shared Expo foundation.

apps.name: Expo App-Shell Scaffold
apps.description: The current reusable Expo auth, social, profile, settings, and app-shell baseline.

apps.name: Calendar
apps.description: A focused calendar for personal schedules and useful shared calendars.

apps.name: Tasks
apps.description: A simple local-first to-do list that helps finish work without turning attention into a feed.

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.description: Fast offline conversion for common length, mass, temperature, volume, and speed units.

apps.name: Habits
apps.description: A calm local-first habit tracker with simple daily check-ins and weekly targets.

apps.name: Money
apps.description: A private local ledger for recording income and expenses without connecting a bank account.

apps.name: Contraction Timer
apps.description: A timing log for contraction starts, durations, intervals, and recent averages without medical diagnosis.

apps.name: Flashlight
apps.description: A deliberately tiny flashlight utility with no unnecessary account or tracking.

apps.name: Timer & Stopwatch
apps.description: Timers and stopwatch tools designed for quick use and immediate exit.

apps.name: Shopping List
apps.description: A quick local-first list for ordinary shopping and household errands.

apps.name: Notes
apps.description: Plain notes with user control, portability, and a calm editing experience.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: A straightforward calculator for common arithmetic without distractions.

apps.name: Gratitude Journal
apps.description: A private journal for deliberate reflection rather than engagement streaks.

apps.name: Keep in Touch
apps.description: Gentle reminders to maintain real relationships without building a social feed.

apps.name: Borrow & Lend
apps.description: Track borrowed and lent items so ordinary commitments are easy to remember.

apps.name: Repair Log
apps.description: Keep a practical history of repairs, maintenance, and stewardship of possessions.

apps.name: Wardrobe
apps.description: A private local clothing catalog with inspectable similarity between pieces you already own.

apps.name: Nearby History
apps.description: Align a sourced reconstruction with a known historical place and blend between the present view and the past.
